title: Saint Gregory the Illuminator Cathedral
visualBrief: Individual Saint Gregory the Illuminator Cathedral, Yerevan: warm tan stone complex with large rear church and steep brown stone roof planes, tall paired-slit polygonal drum/faceted cone/cross, two lower western chapel pavilions and cupolas, projecting west gateway/bell shaft with paired slots, open small bell arcade, deep round central portal and stacked flanking bays. Flat narthex roof with a blue polygonal skylight, stacked side window strips, angular relief crosses and broad local entrance steps. Four existing shared ashlar/limestone/granite/wood graphs, linear tints, metric UVs, flat architectural normals and four browser levels. Current whole footprint/standard DEM. Detailed carving, inscriptions, exact masonry seams, glass artwork, hidden rear windows/rooms/roof joins, park/approach furniture, surveyed plaza/thresholds and certified walking excluded or approximate.

Two lower chapel cupolas, entrance belfry, main drum/roof, blue skylight and three deep front bays are individual architectural forms. Exact stone panel seams/carving/inscriptions, glass artwork, bells/interiors, hidden rear fenestration/rooms/roof joins, park/long approach/lamps and surveyed plaza/thresholds remain approximate or excluded. Native belfry openings are real voids; other doors/windows have closed geometric backing. Physical laptop/phone timing pending.

Skyline keeps the complete massing, large/two smaller chapel cupolas, entrance belfry and skylight. District adds shared surfaces, flat slits/bays, relief cross and open small bell arcade. Street adds actual recesses, deep portal/backing and larger mullions. Closeup/master refine nested surrounds and triangular pediment trim. Synthetic cottage context is a review fixture.
